column1: # Declared verdict expectations for the hand-authored entry points.
# Read by run_tests.sh (tiers 1 and 2). The generated measurement instances
# declare their own expectations in evaluation/instances/expectations.tsv,
# which generate_instances.py writes; do not add them here.
# Format: TAB-separated. Paths are relative to this directory (the Docker
# mount), so each row maps to /work/<path>.
#   generate   expected verdict of `refinery generate`, or SKIP
#   source     where the expectation comes from
# Verdicts: SAT | UNSAT | UNKNOWN (run and report, never fail) | SKIP.
# generate is SKIP for the UNSAT check-k rows: generation from an instance that
# is already not concretizable is unsatisfiable by construction and adds nothing.
# probe_common_parent is the exception — it is a generate-side probe and
# README.md records its verdict under that operation.
# A .problem file on disk with no row here (and none in the generated manifest)
# fails tier 2. Adding an instance means declaring what it should do.
